items.name: Sonoran Chicken Bowl
items.description: Grilled chicken, cilantro-lime rice, black beans, roasted corn, pico de gallo and Saguaro Green Sauce.

items.name: Carne Asada Bowl
items.description: Grilled marinated steak, cilantro-lime rice, pinto beans, grilled onions, cotija and Chipotle Crema.

items.name: Green Chile Pork Bowl
items.description: Pork slow-braised in green chile, brown rice, black beans, pickled red onion and queso fresco.

items.name: Desert Harvest Veggie Bowl
items.description: Roasted squash, sweet potato and peppers, brown rice, black beans and pepitas with Cilantro Lime Dressing.

items.name: Spicy Tofu Bowl
items.description: Crispy tofu, brown rice, charred broccoli and cabbage slaw with Gochujang Glaze.

items.name: Avocado Crunch Salad
items.description: Romaine and mixed greens, sliced avocado, tortilla strips, corn and cherry tomatoes with Cilantro Lime Dressing.

items.name: Mesquite BBQ Chicken Bowl
items.description: Mesquite-grilled chicken, brown rice, crunchy slaw and roasted corn with Mesquite BBQ.

items.name: Street Corn Elote Bowl
items.description: Charred street corn with cotija and chili-lime, black beans and cilantro-lime rice with Chipotle Crema.

items.name: Hatch Chile Steak Bowl
items.description: Grilled steak, roasted Hatch green chiles, cilantro-lime rice, pinto beans and queso fresco.

items.name: Kale Caesar Power Bowl
items.description: Kale and romaine, grilled chicken, parmesan and toasted seeds with a lemony Caesar dressing.

items.name: Gochujang Chicken Bowl
items.description: Gochujang-glazed chicken, brown rice, cucumber, pickled carrots and sesame.
